title: Write draft-atwood-jmap-graph-search-00.md
description: Search over annotations/content/structure deliberately excluded from graph core. Direction discussed: servers advertise supported query languages (e.g. ISO GQL 39075, openCypher, GraphQL+schema, a simple native one), none mandatory. GraphQL rejected as MUST/SHOULD: no search semantics, overlaps JMAP.
notes: Mark 2026-10-20 decision: servers ADVERTISE supported query languages (none mandatory among foreign ones: gql, opencypher, gremlin, sparql, ...), PLUS we define our own small MQL-style JSON filter language in the search draft. Other candidates surveyed: Gremlin/TinkerPop (JVM, implementation-defined, side effects), openCypher (folding into GQL), ISO GQL 39075 (paywalled, huge), SQL/PGQ, SPARQL (RDF misfit), PGQL/AQL/GSQL/nGQL (vendor), Datalog (no spec), MQL/DocumentDB (JSON fits JMAP filters; no SDO spec).
close_reason: Drafted; 9 confirmed review findings applied (collation default=codepoint, well-formedness + error mapping, $in array rule, Gremlin labels, SPARQL Federated ref, pinned versions openCypher 9 / TinkerPop 3.7 / DocumentDB 1.0, design-note fixes); builds clean
